evidence.note: Match.when({ endOfLineHyphen: true }) then Match.when({ whitespace: true }) then orElse; combined-true is never a distinct arm.
MINIMAL_FOLD_SEGMENTS is an alternation; capture groups 1 and 2 cannot both be defined on one match, so the writer never constructs combined-true.

notes: Segment kind literal end-of-line-hyphen|whitespace|other flattened into two exclusive capture-group flags.

disqualifier.note: Inline Effect FileSystem remove options at the atomic-write cleanup call; force and recursive are independent platform-fs SDK knobs, and this call sets both true.
